verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents its own Managed Postgres as a fully-managed service that handles production PostgreSQL operations, so the core of the story exists. The evidence never mentions point-in-time recovery, read replicas, or high-availability failover. Community reports of Postgres machines going down describe hands-on reliability problems, but they appear to concern Postgres machines rather than a documented HA claim, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented point-in-time recovery, documented replicas, documented high availability/failover, independent corroboration of managed Postgres reliability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision a fully-managed Postgres database with point-in-time recovery, replicas, and high availability

citations.quote: Fly.io's Managed Postgres is our fully-managed database service that handles all aspects of running production PostgreSQL databases
